verdict.rationale: BVNK documents API-driven stablecoin sends and payouts, and a probe found an official agent-wallet CLI, which suggests a first-party agent payment path. Nothing in the pack shows how that CLI works or any spend limits or scoped permissions a human configures. Missing for 10: documented agent payment flow details, human-configured spend controls/limits, scoped agent credentials or permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured

citations.quote: Send stablecoins or cryptocurrencies from your BVNK account.
It is possible to create both a payout to themselves (first party) or a payout to another bank account (third party).
